verdict.rationale: Dunning is a fair question for a subscription-management platform like RevenueCat, especially one that offers its own web billing, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers dunning sequences, branded recovery emails, in-app billing-issue banners, grace periods, or final-state rules (cancel vs unpaid). The only related item is a community feature request for timed notification hooks, which points to a gap rather than a delivered capability.
